proof:
Source.
- This is steps 2–3 of the selected node's supplied proof (step 6 of the grandparent proof, supports of the blow-ups), with spt T replaced by an arbitrary set S.
- Step 1 there (u = η_{x,σ}(y) with y ∈ spt T) is here just the definition of membership in the image η_{x,σ}(S).
- Cf. Simon 7.3.3(2), relation (5), η_{x,λ}R_β(S) = R_β(η_{x,λ#}S), with h(spt S, L, ρ, x) from (3) (book/chapter-07.txt lines 512–531).

Notation.
- |·| = ‖·‖ is the Euclidean norm of ℝ^P = Euclid P, and dist(y, x) = |y − x|.
- η := η_{x,σ} = dilation x σ. By the Contract definitions, dilationCLM P σ = σ⁻¹ • id, so η(y) = −σ⁻¹x + σ⁻¹y.
- p := Q.starProjection : ℝ^P →L[ℝ] ℝ^P is the orthogonal projection onto Q. Its instance is Submodule.HasOrthogonalProjection.ofCompleteSpace, since Q is finite-dimensional and hence complete. Only the ℝ-linearity of p is used: p(c·v) = c·p(v).

Hypotheses: σ > 0, β ∈ ℝ (no sign assumption), and
 (H) |(y − x) − p(y − x)| < βσ for every y ∈ S with dist(y, x) < σ.
Claim: every u ∈ η(S) with |u| < 1 satisfies |u − p(u)| < β.

1. Let u ∈ η(S) with |u| < 1. By definition of the image, there is y ∈ S with u = η(y).
2. Since σ > 0, σ ≠ 0 and σσ⁻¹ = 1. Hence σu = σ(−σ⁻¹x + σ⁻¹y) = −(σσ⁻¹)x + (σσ⁻¹)y = −x + y = y − x.
3. Therefore dist(y, x) = |y − x| = |σu| = |σ|·|u| = σ|u|, as σ > 0. Since |u| < 1 and σ > 0, σ|u| < σ·1 = σ. So dist(y, x) < σ.
4. Since y ∈ S and dist(y, x) < σ, hypothesis (H) gives |(y − x) − p(y − x)| < βσ.
5. By step 2 and the linearity of p, (y − x) − p(y − x) = σu − p(σu) = σu − σp(u) = σ(u − p(u)). Hence |(y − x) − p(y − x)| = |σ|·|u − p(u)| = σ|u − p(u)|.
6. Combining steps 4 and 5, σ|u − p(u)| < βσ = σβ. Since σ ≥ 0, and a·b < a·c with a ≥ 0 implies b < c, we get |u − p(u)| < β. As u was an arbitrary point of η(S) with |u| < 1, the claim is proved. ∎

|y − x| = σ|u| < σ, so the flatness hypothesis applies to y: |(y − x) − p_Q(y − x)| < βσ.
